name: sol8-focused-screenshot
goal: Fetch an explicitly selected passed focused screenshot without weakening failed-record or integrity guards

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: An explicit focused scenario may fetch a passed usable screenshot with its original record, bytes and hash; default selection and failed focused records remain unchanged.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing four download tests covered full-record selection and integrity only. Extend those cases with focused record binding, implicit refusal, failed or incomplete refusal and integrity checks.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 3f97de0ce0 fails the existing download suite because an explicitly selected passed focused capture is rejected before artifact retrieval.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 3a099228d9 permits only explicitly selected passed usable focused screenshots, retaining original artifact binding, full-status null and all integrity checks.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged four-case download suite passes at 3a099228d9. It refuses implicit, failed, incomplete, unusable and failed-capture focused records and retains SHA-256 rejection.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
